rules.quote: Don’t add full stops to the ends of headings, page headers, footers or captions.
rules.violation_condition: A heading, page header, footer or caption ends with a full stop.
when: Applies to headings, page headers, footers and captions.
rules.why: G-1 and G-2: retain the specific punctuation check and combine the listed content types as conditions.

rules.quote: Don’t use a semicolon at the end of each item in a bullet list.
rules.violation_condition: A bullet list uses semicolons as item-ending punctuation.
when: Applies to bullet-list item endings, not semicolons within an item's text.
rules.why: G-1: this is a specific check rather than the parent section's general recommendation.

rules.quote: Unless each item is a full sentence or the last item in a list, don’t use a full stop for items in bullet lists.
rules.violation_condition: A non-final bullet-list item ends with a full stop although the list's items are not all full sentences.
when: Does not prohibit full stops when every item is a full sentence.
Does not prohibit a full stop on the final item.
The exceptions permit full stops; this sentence does not require them.
rules.why: G-2 and G-3: keep one prohibition with its full-sentence and final-item exceptions.

rules.quote: Don’t use full stops between letters in an acronym or initialism.
rules.violation_condition: An acronym or initialism contains full stops between its letters.
when: The letters form an acronym or initialism.
rules.why: G-1: retain the specific check for internal punctuation of shortened forms.

rules.quote: Don’t use a full stop at the end of most abbreviations.
rules.specification: The page does not identify the exceptions to ‘most abbreviations’. An abbreviation-specific reference is needed before deciding which forms violate this rule.
rules.violation_condition: An abbreviation has a final full stop despite not belonging to an exception that retains one.
when: Exclude abbreviations whose prescribed form retains a final full stop.
A full stop that ends the surrounding sentence is not an abbreviation-ending full stop.
rules.why: G-2: preserve the stated exception category without inventing its membership.

rules.quote: Include a single space after a punctuation mark at the end of a sentence.
rules.specification: Interpret this as intersentence spacing in running text, allowing closing quotation marks or brackets before the space. Check missing separation here; repeated spaces are covered by the separate prohibition on double spaces.
rules.violation_condition: Adjacent sentences in running text have no separating space after the first sentence's terminal punctuation and any closing quotation mark or bracket.
when: Another sentence follows in the same paragraph.
Do not require a trailing space at the end of a paragraph or document.
rules.why: The grain test separates missing sentence separation from the independently stated prohibition on repeated spaces.

rules.violation_condition: The text contains a run of two or more consecutive spaces.
rules.why: The grain test separates repeated spaces anywhere in text from a missing intersentence space.
